# EARTH, The Movie

> EARTH is a satirical feature film made with AI-generated characters, from Madwackd Productions. It is planned for Summer 2027 at watchvrmovie.com. theearthmovie.com is the official waitlist and sneak-peek site.

## Facts
- Title: EARTH (also called The Earth Movie)
- Studio: Madwackd Productions (https://www.madwackd.com/)
- Director and producer: Zach Wennstedt
- Release: planned for Summer 2027; no exact date announced
- Where to watch: watchvrmovie.com, an online theater for VR headsets, phones, tablets and computers ("a theater NOT near you")
- Price: ticket details not yet announced
- Story: a backwards world hooked on its feeds; one guy wakes up; the lesson is that love and kindness are worth more than money
- Rating intent: family friendly, no cussing, with adult allegories
- AI disclosure: EARTH uses AI-generated characters, voices and imagery. Any resemblance to real persons is coincidental.
- Trailer: not released yet
- Updates: join the waitlist at https://www.theearthmovie.com/#join
